div.p: No worries, Boss — let's slow down and go step by step, very simply.
The problem: the link https://ibb.co only goes to the ImgBB website, not to your actual logo picture. That's why nothing shows — the browser tries to load a whole website as an icon, and fails.

p.strong: Here's exactly what to do, one step at a time:
Step 1 — Upload your logo image to ImgBB

ol.class: [li_&]:mb-0 [li_&]:mt-1 [li_&]:gap-1 [&:not(:last-child)_ul]:pb-1 [&:not(:last-child)_ol]:pb-1 list-decimal flex flex-col gap-1 pl-8 mb-3 print:block print:space-y-1
ol.li: Choose your logo image file (a square PNG works best — like 512x512 or 256x256 pixels)

p.strong: Step 2 — Get the CORRECT link (this is the part that keeps going wrong)
p.br: After it uploads, ImgBB shows you a box with several different links. There are usually 3-4 options like:

ul.class: [li_&]:mb-0 [li_&]:mt-1 [li_&]:gap-1 [&:not(:last-child)_ul]:pb-1 [&:not(:last-child)_ol]:pb-1 list-disc flex flex-col gap-1 pl-8 mb-3 print:block print:space-y-1
ul.li: "Direct links" ← this is the one you need

div.p:
Under "Direct links", there will be a link that ends in .jpg or .png — something like:
https://i.ibb.co/xxxxxxx/logo.png
Important: notice it starts with i.ibb.co (with the "i.") — NOT just ibb.co. That little "i." is what makes it point to the actual image instead of the website.
Step 4 — Send that link to me and I'll write the exact line of code for you to paste into index.html.
Go try Step 1 and 2 now, Boss, and paste me the link you get — I'll handle the rest.

div.p: Why this works: Vite automatically serves everything inside the public/ folder from the root of your site. So if logo.png sits in public/logo.png, it becomes accessible at yoursite.com/logo.png — that's why the href is just /logo.png, not the full GitHub URL.

ol.li: Click the pencil (✏️) icon to edit

Replace line 7:
From: <link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="https://ibb.co" />
To: <link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="/logo.png" />
Scroll down, commit the change (commit directly to main)
Wait a minute or two for Cloudflare to auto-redeploy, then refresh your site tab

div.p: That should make the logo show up as the tab icon. Want me to also check the exact filename/capitalization matches once you confirm it — logo.png vs Logo.png matters on GitHub since it's case-sensitive?

div.p: Here's a clean, simple green tooth — no background, no card, just the icon itself.

If you like this shape, Boss, I'll turn it into a real downloadable PNG file you can drop straight into your project's public/ folder as logo.png (or favicon.png), so it's ready to reference in index.html. Want me to generate that file?

div.p: Here's the raw SVG code for that green tooth — you can save this directly as logo.png's SVG version, or use it as an inline favicon:

div.class: relative group/copy bg-bg-000/50 border-0.5 border-border-400 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-accent-100
sticky opacity-0 group-hover/copy:opacity-100 group-focus-within/copy:opacity-100 top-2 py-2 h-12 w-0 float-right
absolute right-0 h-8 px-2 items-center inline-flex z-10

button.class: inline-flex items-center justify-center relative isolate shrink-0 can-focus select-none disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 disabled:shadow-none disabled:drop-shadow-none border-transparent transition font-base duration-300 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.165,0.85,0.45,1)] h-8 w-8 rounded-md backdrop-blur-md _fill_19tw7_9 _ghost_19tw7_96

div.style: width: 20px; height: 20px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
width: 20px; height: 20px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;

pre.style: color: rgb(234, 236, 240); background: transparent; font-family: var(--font-mono);

code.style: color: rgb(234, 236, 240); background: transparent; font-family: var(--font-mono); white-space: pre;

div.p: To use it as your favicon, you actually don't need a PNG at all — modern browsers support SVG favicons directly. In index.html, change the favicon line to:

div.class: relative group/copy bg-bg-000/50 border-0.5 border-border-400 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-accent-100
sticky opacity-0 group-hover/copy:opacity-100 group-focus-within/copy:opacity-100 top-2 py-2 h-12 w-0 float-right
absolute right-0 h-8 px-2 items-center inline-flex z-10

button.class: inline-flex items-center justify-center relative isolate shrink-0 can-focus select-none disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 disabled:shadow-none disabled:drop-shadow-none border-transparent transition font-base duration-300 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.165,0.85,0.45,1)] h-8 w-8 rounded-md backdrop-blur-md _fill_19tw7_9 _ghost_19tw7_96

div.style: width: 20px; height: 20px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
width: 20px; height: 20px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;

pre.style: color: rgb(234, 236, 240); background: transparent; font-family: var(--font-mono);

code.style: color: rgb(234, 236, 240); background: transparent; font-family: var(--font-mono); white-space: pre;

div.p: Then save the code above as logo.svg in your public/ folder on GitHub (instead of logo.png).
Want me to generate the actual downloadable .svg file for you now so you can just upload it straight to GitHub?

div.p: Sorry for the confusion, Boss — let me explain plainly, then just make you the actual file so there's no more back-and-forth.

What that code was: It's called SVG (a way to draw an image using text/code instead of pixels). It's not an HTML page — it's just image instructions. When you saved it, if your computer named it .html or opened it in a text editor, that's just a file-saving mixup, not something wrong with the code itself.
Let me just make you the real file now — a proper .svg image file you can directly download and upload to GitHub, no copy-pasting code needed.

div.p: There's the actual file, Boss — click it above to download logo.svg to your computer.

p.strong: Now, step by step, how to add it to GitHub:

ol.class: [li_&]:mb-0 [li_&]:mt-1 [li_&]:gap-1 [&:not(:last-child)_ul]:pb-1 [&:not(:last-child)_ol]:pb-1 list-decimal flex flex-col gap-1 pl-8 mb-3 print:block print:space-y-1
ol.li: Download that file — save it as logo.svg on your computer (Downloads folder is fine)
Go to your GitHub repo in the browser: github.com/amirandoboy-sketch/kena
Navigate into the public folder (click on it)
Click "Add file" (top right area, near the "Go to file" search box) → "Upload files"
Drag your downloaded logo.svg into the upload box, or click to browse and select it

ol.class: [li_&]:mb-0 [li_&]:mt-1 [li_&]:gap-1 [&:not(:last-child)_ul]:pb-1 [&:not(:last-child)_ol]:pb-1 list-decimal flex flex-col gap-1 pl-8 mb-3 print:block print:space-y-1
ol.li: Go back and open index.html, click the pencil (✏️) to edit
Find the favicon line and change it to:
